author: fujii
text: Proposal from the org design team: move Platform to a job-based structure with fixed role definitions, like our US partner. Thoughts before Friday?

author: kei
text: I'd push back on copying the structure without the reason. Northwind ships faster because each service has one accountable owner, not because roles are fixed. If we import fixed roles without ownership we get the slowness plus the rigidity. Suggest we pilot 'one owner per service' for a quarter first and measure lead time.

author: hayashi
text: Agree with Kei that we should measure before we reorganize.
